sources.snippet: The example keeps initialization from an existing checkpoint explicit. Only set train.paths.model_path: null if you intentionally want to initialize from common.model.base_model_path (the public Qwen model by default), rather than a previously trained CADRec checkpoint. Changing initialization weights is not the same as resuming a Trainer run.

sources.title: PDF CADRec: Reconstructing a CAD Sequence Recursively with Localized ...
sources.snippet: We further train the model with geometry-aware objectives that encourage consistent part decomposition and spatially grounded predictions. Experiments on standard CAD reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate that CADRec improves both geometric fidelity and program validity over prior sequence- and code-based baselines.

sources.title: CaDRec: Contextualized and Debiased Recommender Model
sources.snippet: This paper proposes a contextualized and debiased recommender model (CaDRec). To overcome the over-smoothing issue, we explore a novel hypergraph convolution operator that can select effective neighbors during convolution by introducing both structural context and sequential context.
